data.one_liner: Provides annotations for json_serializable to generate JSON (de)serialization code.
data.what_it_does: Defines annotation classes like @JsonSerializable and @JsonKey that json_serializable reads to produce boilerplate for converting Dart objects to and from JSON. It does not contain any runtime logic itself.
use_when: You need compile‑time JSON (de)serialization without writing manual toJson/fromJson code.
You are already using json_serializable or want a lightweight annotation package.
avoid_when: You prefer runtime reflection‑based JSON handling (e.g., json_annotation is not needed).
You target platforms where code generation is not possible.
strengths: Works with Dart 3 and newer SDKs.
Provides fine‑grained control via JsonKey options.
weaknesses: Requires a separate code‑gen step with build_runner and json_serializable.
Only useful when paired with a generator; on its own it does nothing.
data.setup_notes: Add json_annotation to pubspec, then run build_runner with json_serializable (e.g., flutter pub run build_runner build).

alternatives.name: json_serializable
alternatives.why_pick_it: Combines annotations and code generation in one package, so you can skip adding json_annotation separately.
